text: The bath water soothed her skin with gentle warmth.
The bath water scalded her skin with intense heat.
The blanket rested softly against his body.
The blanket scraped roughly against his irritated skin.
The breeze cooled her cheeks pleasantly.
The breeze stung her cheeks with biting cold.
The massage released the tension in his shoulders.
The massage pressed on his injury and made his shoulders ache.
The pillow cushioned her neck comfortably.
The pillow strained her neck until it hurt.
The shoes supported his feet comfortably on the walk.
The shoes rubbed his feet until blisters stung on the walk.
The shower gently refreshed her tired body.
The shower struck her sunburned body with painful force.
The scarf felt smooth and soothing against his neck.
The scarf felt scratchy and made his neck sting.
The swimming water refreshed her skin after the heat.
The swimming water irritated her skin and made it burn.
The stretch eased the tightness in his leg.
The stretch pulled his injured leg and caused a sharp ache.
The tea warmed her throat pleasantly.
The tea burned her throat when she swallowed.
The seat supported his back and helped him relax.
The seat pressed against his injured back and made it throb.
The cream soothed her dry hands.
The cream made the cuts on her hands sting.
The grass felt soft beneath his bare feet.
The grass concealed sharp thorns that pierced his bare feet.
The breeze from the fan felt refreshing on her skin.
The hot air from the fan felt scorching on her skin.
The warm pack eased the ache in his muscles.
The overheated pack burned the skin over his muscles.
The towel touched her face with a soft, soothing warmth.
The towel rubbed her raw face and caused a sharp sting.
The cool cloth brought relief to his forehead.
The coarse cloth scraped his forehead painfully.
The ripe peach tasted sweet and pleasant in her mouth.
The sour peach irritated the sore inside her mouth.
The slippers cushioned his feet as he stood.
The tight slippers squeezed his swollen toes until they ached.
The gentle sunlight felt pleasant against her arms.
The harsh sunlight left her arms burning with sunburn.
The mattress allowed his body to rest comfortably.
The broken mattress pressed into his ribs painfully.
The cool gel soothed the skin on her wrist.
The strong gel made the raw skin on her wrist sting.
The smooth pebble felt pleasantly cool in his palm.
The sharp pebble cut his palm and caused a sudden sting.
The warm soup felt comforting as she swallowed.
The boiling soup burned her tongue as she swallowed.
The loose glove felt soft around his fingers.
The tight glove squeezed his injured fingers painfully.
The gentle combing felt pleasant against her scalp.
The rough combing pulled her hair and made her scalp hurt.
The cool floor felt refreshing beneath his feet.
The jagged floor scraped his feet and made them bleed.
The soft cushion supported her elbow comfortably.
The hard edge pressed into her elbow and made it ache.
The gentle touch eased the tension in his arm.
The forceful touch aggravated the bruise on his arm.
